messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INV-4521 — inference-service error-rate spike (5xx) across prod-us-east-1. Grouping: inference-service. Count: 270 in last 5m. auto-grouped=true

maria (oncall): seeing it, ack'ing PD. grabbing quick metrics.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INV-4521 acknowledged by maria. Escalation paused.

kevin: on the metrics dash — p50 latency OK, but 5xx ratio jumped at 23:04 UTC, correlates with canary rollout v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0.

maria (oncall): good catch. rolling canary back now unless someone objects.

charlie: +1 rollback. also we should silence noisy duplicates while we investigate — paging storm incoming.

maria (oncall): creating temporary silence for PD-INV-4521 and any alerts with fingerprint tag inference-5xx-canary. silence 15m.

kevin: quick command to rollback canary:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-canary inference=registry/redwood/inference:2.3.1 --record
```

maria (oncall): rollback triggered. scaling canary down to 0 pods.

ops-rotation: FYI, I saw ~12 duplicate alerts in PagerDuty within 2m. We need dedupe key tightened. current dedupe is service+region only. Suggest adding deploy_hash.

charlie: agree. I'll update suppression rules after we stabilize. For now we should set PD suppression rule: if alert fingerprint matches canary-deploy-*, suppress escalation for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: Silence created: PD-SILENCE-879 by maria (15m). Suppressing escalation for grouped alerts matching inference-5xx-canary.

kevin: rollback completed at 23:10 UTC, canary pods terminated. errors trending down on the next scrape.

maria (oncall): errors down to baseline ~1.2% (was 6.8%). No major customer-facing outages reported yet but partial errors for some EU customers between 23:04-23:09 UTC. Notify support to check affected customer list?

charlie: I'll open an internal tracker for impacted customers and ask support to reach out if needed.

ops-rotation: note for postmortem: incident-bot auto-grouping combined deployment and 5xx spike into one group which caused a paging storm. Need to refine grouping rules: prioritize origin=runtime_error over deploy events, and include deploy_hash to dedupe.

maria (oncall): temporary mitigation checklist:
- rollback canary (done)
- silence duplicate pages (done)
- scale inference replicas by +20% in us-east (k8s HPA bump)
- file postmortem draft and add timeline

kevin: bump HPA: kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}' -> applied.

pagerduty-bot: Alert PD-INV-4521 resolved by auto-close rule after no new 5xx for 10m.

maria (oncall): handing off to night oncall charlie for follow-up and postmortem drafting. I'm OOO in 30m. Please pick up any lingering tickets.

charlie: ack handoff. I'll own the postmortem and suppression rule change. Quick todo:
- add deploy_hash to dedupe key (eng-sre config)
- adjust auto-grouping to separate deploy alerts from runtime spikes unless correlation > 90%
- add a PagerDuty escalation quiesce for 10m when rollback triggered by oncall

ops-rotation: logging the customer impact: approx 0.8% of total requests failed in EU for 5 minutes (~3 customers showed spike in errors). No SLA breach.

maria (oncall): thanks team. closing thread after postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:

charlie: starting postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/pm/PD-INV-4521 (will ping when ready).
